Phir teen sau feet lamba steel ka hissa seedhe pani mein doob jata hai. Ab socho jaise swimming pool mein ek pencil seedhi tair rahi ho. Iski zyada tar body gahrai mein hone se badi lahrein bhi ise hila nahi patin. Aur yahin twist hai har kamre mein do darwaze aur ghumne wale toilet hain. Matlab jab yeh ghumta hai to deewarein turant naya farsh ban jati hain. Wapas seedha hone ke liye pressure se pani bahar nikal diya jata hai. Kya tum aise ship par rahoge?
